spikes.question: Which registry does the scope gate's lifecycle-artifact classifier consult, and do the ProofStory intent artifacts really fall through to out_of_scope there?
spikes.note: Read-only investigation; no disposable code paths (repro via node -e against built dist).
spikes.result: Confirmed: classifyScopePath (packages/main/src/core/scope-path-classifier.ts) delegates to classifyLifecycleArtifact (packages/main/src/core/lifecycle-registry.ts), whose closed set LATTICE_LIFECYCLE_ARTIFACT_FILENAMES is the single registry and single consumer site (grep shows no other consumers). Repro against built main dist: all ten ProofStory filenames written by the store.ts intent-hardening block (original-intent-snapshot, milestone-ledger, milestone-closeout, slice-plan, parent-ledger-rollup, proofstory, intent-collision, scope-shrinkage-decision, red-evidence, spike) classify rule=unknown/BLOCKED under an enforce contract, while checklist.json classifies lifecycle_artifact PASS. Code path is fully understood; fix is a data-level registry addition.
